summary: Simple Divorce has a large team, a clear service structure and several ways to book. Dead menu links, conflicting numbers and cut off text weaken trust for clients who are choosing a lawyer under stress.

findings.problem: Many menu items link to #, including About, Practice Areas, Help Center, Litigation, Arbitration, Common Law and several Help Center sections.
findings.cost: A client who clicks Practice Areas and sees nothing happen leaves, and your best content goes unseen.
findings.fix: Working menus and a simple structure of the five services clients look for most.

findings.problem: The page says 5,700+ divorces and also 3,000+ satisfied clients, and Since 2013 does not match 16 years in business.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers make clients doubt every claim, which is the opposite of what a proof section should do.
findings.fix: One verified set of numbers shown the same way everywhere.

findings.problem: Testimonials are cut off mid thought with ellipses, with no dates. Typos include proccess, Divison of Property, reccomend and Salmon for Salman.
findings.cost: Cut off reviews and typos in a law firm's own copy weaken the trust the testimonials are meant to build.
findings.fix: Full, dated reviews and a proofread build.

findings.problem: The consultation form appears two or three times, and booking goes to a separate domain (sadiqlaw.as.me). There is no chat or WhatsApp.
findings.cost: A client sent to an unfamiliar domain may question whether it is legitimate, and repeated forms split your enquiries.
findings.fix: One form on your own domain, one booking button and a chat or WhatsApp option.

redesign: A consultation first homepage with one clear button, one short form and a visible price summary.
Practice area pages that work, written to rank for searches like uncontested divorce Toronto and separation agreement Toronto.
Proof beside every button: full dated reviews, one set of verified numbers and your team.
